title: DeepSeekMoE: Towards Ultimate Expert Specialization in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
layout_note: Three MoE layers drawn on the same template in a row, separated by dashed vertical rules, each adding one change to the previous: (a) the conventional layer, (b) with the experts split finer, (c) the full proposed layer. A caption row under them links (a) -> (b) -> (c) with thick dark arrows.
grouping: Each variant is an unboxed column with the same vertical order: Input Hidden at the bottom, Router, a row of numbered expert boxes, gate multipliers, a single sum, Output Hidden on top. A dashed rounded legend box in the top-right corner names the two expert fills (routed vs shared).
shapes_depth: Flat rounded rectangles with dark thin outlines: pale-blue routed experts numbered 1..N (wide boxes in (a), twice as many narrow ones 1..2N in (b) and (c)), a pale-yellow Router box, hidden states as a rounded box holding two circles. Router scores are a tiny yellow bar chart beside the router with the number of chosen experts written as K = 2 / 4 / 3; yellow dashed curves carry the scores to circled-times gates above the chosen experts; solid black curves for token paths; a circled plus sums the outputs.
proposed_highlight: The added piece is one green expert (the shared expert, box 1 in (c)) wired straight from the input, bypassing the router; it is the only green in the figure and has a legend entry. The final panel's bold label adds the method name in parentheses.
lesson: Build the proposed layer as the last of a row of identical templates, each adding one change, so the reader sees exactly what differs (twice as many narrower experts, then one green always-on expert), and write the number of selected experts K under each router.
notes: 'other' element = the hidden-state glyph (a rounded box with two circles) at both ends of each column. Venue from Semantic Scholar (ACL); year = venue year 2024, which matches the arXiv preprint year.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
